package.name: us3d_vlm
package.description:
Vision-Language Model integration for the US 3D scanning system.
Connects to a vLLM-style OpenAI-compatible HTTP server hosting a multimodal model (e.g. Qwen2-VL, InternVL, Llama-3.2-Vision). Two nodes are provided:
* phantom_recognizer_node — looks at the camera color frame and publishes a us3d_msgs/PhantomInfo describing the phantom on the table. * instruction_planner_node — converts a natural-language scan instruction into structured scan parameters and dispatches them to the existing curved-surface scan_planner.
The VLM never emits robot waypoints directly; it only produces semantic-level hints, which are validated against safety limits before being applied.
